items.item:
2. Adding one `draft-write` node produces a version an agent cannot activate —
   the refusal keeps nothing for the owner — and the owner can.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a06_effectful_flow_owner_only_activation]
statements:
```text
flow_activation -> proven(flow_version) at activation
highest_effect_class = read  -> activated_by = kernel
highest_effect_class > read  -> activated_by = owner
agent_asks(effectful) -> refused AND nothing_kept
new_flow_version -/> inherits(activation | grant | approval)
```

verdicts.why: The selected test detects the draft-write version as proven and effectful, refuses an agent without changing the prior activation, and permits owner activation; it also exercises kernel activation of the preceding read-only version. It does not establish that proof is recomputed at activation, and it does not test that a new version inherits no grant or approval, so the full bound invariant is only partially asserted.
